summary.description: FEB markets the 21700-68E as a 6500mAh cylindrical cell. Battery Mooch tested the exact model and estimated 13A continuous current, describing it as a strong energy cell; the samples lacked CCC marks and appeared pre-production.
highlights: Exact identity is supported by FEB model naming and an exact-model vaping test.
Discovery value is 6500mAh and 13A continuous; no higher temperature-limited rating was established.
The tested samples appeared pre-production, so production continuity and wrapper revision need follow-up.
Runtime admission is recorded as battery-90.
Runtime admission is recorded separately from editorial visibility.

claims.statement: The exact candidate identity is FEB 21700-68E, also called FEB 21700G or 68E.
The manufacturer-linked data and exact test identify 6350mAh minimum and 6500mAh nominal capacity.
Battery Mooch estimated 13A continuous current and observed about 65C at that load; no higher temperature-limited or pulse rating was established.
The exact FEB 21700-68E has an eligible exact-model vaping battery test.
The current Steam Engine battery catalog contains no exact FEB 21700-68E preset.
